title: BifrostTableEntry
description:
Lightweight table listing entry — one row of the list-tables response.

Schema-free by design (review M-04): the stored schema is carried only by the per-table describe contract, [`BifrostTableDescription`], so the list stays small.

fingerprint.description: Lower-case hex of the 32-byte user-schema fingerprint.

name.description: Name component of the fully-qualified name (`<ns>.<name>` → name).

namespace.description: Namespace component of the fully-qualified name (`<ns>.<name>` → ns).

table_uid.description: Lower-case hex of the 16-byte table uid.

TableStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a registered Bifrost table.

oneOf.description: Table is deprecated but still readable.
Table is quarantined and not writable.
